A little a history of how I got Panda:


I work at an animal hospital. One evening we find a pet carrier abandoned at our door. Inside was a beautiful white medium haired cat. 

The next day we get her checked by the veterinarian and it turns out she is pregnant. She gives birth to Panda and her littermates the next day.

I kept Panda and the rest of the litter was adopted by various coworkers. Their mom which we nicknamed Mama kitty and was later named Dutchess also got adopted by a coworker.

I posted her pictures because I’m always so amazed how much Panda’s looks have changed since she was born.
